Chronology of every recorded fact about [[pathfinding spell]], in reading order. Generated from the same verified fact store as the main article.

== The Captain ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|'''Ch 3''' — The narrator uses a pathfinding spell to visualize a tunnel through the Iron Hive.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|'''Ch 8''' — A pathfinding spell can only locate a known, possible route.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|'''Ch 16''' — A pathfinding spell can be linked to another person.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|'''Ch 18''' — The narrator's pathfinding spell can alert them to enemies.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|'''Ch 44''' — The pathfinding spell is a magic that shines gold in the user's vision when activated.}}

== The Engineer ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|'''Ch 12''' — Pathfinding magic is almost impossible to detect without specialized analysis.}}

== The Knight ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|'''Ch 5''' — A pathfinding spell can be cast by the narrator.}}

== The Pilot ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 37''' — A pathfinding spell can target a specific person.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 42''' — The narrator uses a quick pathfinding spell to track targets.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 42''' — The narrator uses a pathfinding spell by tracing golden runes in the air.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 44''' — The narrator's pathfinding spell can show a golden path.}}
